title: v5.4.0 — Your Devices & Soft-Lock Fix
message: New 'Your Devices' section in Account shows every device you're signed in on — name, OS, browser, location, when you first signed in, and when each device was last active. A green 'THIS DEVICE' pill marks the one you're on. Sign out any single device or 'Sign out all other devices' if something looks wrong. The new sign-in alert popup now shows the new device's full details. Fixed a soft-lock bug where the screen could stay scroll-locked after dismissing the new sign-in alert — body styles are now defensively cleared and the popup is properly tracked alongside other overlays. Cleaning up your own session record on Sign Out so it doesn't linger.
